title: Numbers to 20 - Tens and Ones
introductionText:
Term 2 · Number
Numbers to 20 — Tens and Ones
The Big Idea: Every number from 11 to 19 is one ten and some ones. 16 is one ten and 6
ones. We can also count in tens: 10, 20, 30...
Say It Like This
Read aloud
"Let's make 16. Here is a bundle of ten straws — that's one ten. Now add 6 single straws.
Ten and six make sixteen. Look at how we write it: the 1 means one ten, the 6 means six
ones. When we count in tens, every jump is a whole bundle: ten, twenty, thirty, forty,
fifty."
Watch Out For
The slip almost every child makes
"The 1 in 16 is just one." It isn't — it is a whole bundle of ten. Hold up the bundle every
time you point at the 1.
Writing 61 for sixteen. Because we say the "six" first. Build it with straws: bundle first on
the left, loose straws on the right, then write it in the same order.
Try It at Home
Game 1 — Straw bundles (10 minutes)
Count out 10 straws (or spaghetti sticks) and tie them with a hair elastic. Now call out a
number between 11 and 20: he builds it with the bundle and loose straws. For 20, he
needs a second bundle. Ask: how could you make 20 with just loose straws? Which way is
quicker to check?
Game 2 — Family fingers (5 minutes)
Each person holds up 10 fingers. Count in tens as each person joins: 10, 20, 30... How
many fingers with 4 people? Then start from a different number: he holds up 3 fingers
and each new person adds ten: 3, 13, 23.
Count in tens:
10
= 1 6

tens ones

1 ten 6 ones 50
Point to the ten-stick while he says "one ten", then to each orange cube while he counts the ones. Then say
the tens column aloud together.
More examples to talk about
• 20 is 2 tens and 0 ones. 10 is 1 ten and 0 ones — the zero holds the ones' place.
• 11 is one ten and one one — its name doesn't sound like that, which is why it's hard.
• Ten more than 5 is 15; ten more than 8 is 18. Only the tens digit changes.
• Tricky: counting in tens from 4: 4, 14, 24, 34. The ones digit stays 4 every time!
• To put numbers in order, compare the tens first, then the ones: 9, 12, 15, 20.
Key Words
tens ones digit bundle order estimate count in tens

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Put these in order, smallest first: 15, 9, 20, 12
Omar wrote sixteen as 61. Is he right? Write sixteen correctly.
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: No — 16. The ten is written first.
